findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the degradation on CORE-DNS-01 but does not explicitly state it caused the nationwide traffic drop.
T1 and T2 explicitly show the onset at 12:30 for both metrics on CORE-DNS-01.
T3 and ALM-000365 confirm the alarm type, node, raise time 12:35, and clear time 14:11.
T6 explicitly reports no maintenance window for CORE-DNS-01 and parents in the specified window.
T9 explicitly reports no external events for all regions between 12:00 and 18:00.
